recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7463 unless a future work-group decision changes compartment URL casing.
issue_request: FHIR-7463 was a Published FHIR-core technical correction from the 2015May/DSTU1 ballot asking to change the search page example for procedures in a patient compartment from `GET [base]/Patient/23/Procedure?...` to lowercase `GET [base]/patient/23/Procedure?...`. Its final resolution was Persuasive with Modification and says to resolve the issue per FHIR-7464.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-7463 was found for `source/search.html`. Jira comments say to see FHIR-7464 and that the issue was already applied. FHIR-7464 records svn revision 5671, which maps to git commit ac324ca8a1a86de1d9990a1288aff1720fc0ab6a, `#7464 - compartment documentation improvements`, changing lowercase `/patient` compartment examples to uppercase `/Patient` and removing obsolete compartment URI presentation.
additional_context: FHIR-7464 is already represented on the combined branch by commit 17f92bd74f5ee2b784f94bfe6e2a0b2362b858cd. Current `source/search.html` uses uppercase `GET [base]/Patient/23/Procedure?...` for the exact example raised by FHIR-7463. Source, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no lowercase endpoint examples or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The original lowercase proposal is superseded by the linked FHIR-7464 decision that patient compartment search paths use uppercase `/Patient` in all cases, so changing current source to lowercase would be incorrect.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-7463 was resolved per FHIR-7464, whose accepted resolution selected uppercase `/Patient` for patient compartment search URLs.
